note: Let a language model read an incident's evidence and write the explanation (ADR-029). Nothing runs until a provider is configured here: with no provider there is no client, no credential and no outbound traffic.
unavailable: Configuring the AI provider requires the admin role.
signInHint: Sign in to configure an AI provider.
loadFailed: Could not read the current configuration.

provider.label: Provider
provider.hint: One provider is active at a time. There is deliberately no failover to a second vendor — where an incident's details are sent is a decision, not something to retry elsewhere.
provider.vertex: Vertex AI — Gemini in your own GCP project

egress.stays: Incident context stays inside your own GCP project, in the region you name. Recommended.
egress.leaves: Node names, IP addresses, topology and syslog lines are sent to the vendor, outside your boundary. Device credentials are never included.

field.modelHint: Model ids change faster than Yagra releases, so nothing here checks against a list. The placeholder is a working suggestion.
field.locationHint: Where the request is processed. "global" is accepted, but naming a region is the point of choosing Vertex.
field.serviceAccountHint: Paste the whole key file. Leave it empty on GKE/GCE to use the instance's own identity (Workload Identity) and store no key at all.
field.keyStored: A credential is stored. It is never shown again — leave this alone to keep it.
field.clearHint: Saving with the field empty removes the stored credential.
field.maxTokensHint: Tokens per answer, {{min}}–{{max}}. On current models the model's own reasoning is drawn from this same budget, so a limit trimmed to the visible answer truncates the reply on exactly the hard incidents.
field.enabledHint: Off means the "Explain this incident" button does not appear and nothing is ever sent.

state.unconfigured: No provider configured. AI-assisted analysis is off.

test.hint: Sends one minimal prompt to the saved configuration. Save first — the test reads what is stored, not what is on screen.

err.test: The test could not be run.
err.projectRequired: Vertex AI needs a GCP project and a region.
err.keyRequired: This provider needs an API key.
err.tokensRange: The output limit must be between {{min}} and {{max}}.
